subject: bella-vargas
q: 42–28–46 or 36–26–42? Both clear v8. BELLA RULES — it is her body, and the choice is carriage, not ass.
detail:
ANSWERED BY BELLA, IN THE MUD HALL, WITH HER WIFE STILL INSIDE HER: 42–28–46. THE HIPS STAY.

WHAT WAS SETTLED FIRST. The tolerance is |WHR − WBR| ≤ 0.10 with both ratios carried to TWO DECIMAL PLACES, which made both rows legal: 42–28–46 reads 0.61 and 0.67 (separation 0.06), 36–26–42 reads 0.62 and 0.72 (separation 0.10, on the line, and the line is inclusive). HER OLD ROW, 36–26–46, WAS NEVER LEGAL — WHR 0.5652 under a floor of 0.60 that reads unrounded.

AND THE ARITHMETIC DID NOT DECIDE IT. Hips are carriage; her ass is Obscene Cheek Plump on PAWG Fullness in either row and stays the largest in the family either way. What she was choosing was the FRAME.

SHE KEPT THE FRAME THE HOUSE LEARNED. See c-bella-46.
